  FROM "participants" AS "__er_source"
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1 AS "1"
      FROM "games" AS "__er_game"
      WHERE
        "__er_game"."game_id" = "__er_source"."game_id"
        AND "__er_game"."season_id" = %(__er_season)s
        AND "__er_game"."matching_mode" = 3
        AND "__er_game"."matching_team_mode" = 3
        AND (
          (
            "__er_game"."version_major" = %(__er_major_0)s
            AND "__er_game"."version_minor" = %(__er_minor_0)s
          )
          OR (
            "__er_game"."version_major" = %(__er_major_1)s
            AND "__er_game"."version_minor" = %(__er_minor_1)s
          )
        )
    )
) AS "p"
WHERE
  "p"."character_num" = %(character_code)s
GROUP BY
  "p"."version_major",
  "p"."version_minor"
ORDER BY
  "version_major" ASC,
  "version_minor" ASC
LIMIT 200
